messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.58
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl (1.58) has been released at its website (https://rqtl.org) and on CRAN. Windows and Mac binaries will be available on CRAN within a few days.

There was just a small change to avoid a warning in tests on CRAN.

Karl Broman
